labels.t_route: Route and forward to the corresponding node
labels._title: ES write flow: the coordinating node routes the request and responds after primary and replica finish
labels._desc: The ES client picks a node that becomes the coordinating node, which routes the write to the node holding the primary shard; the primary syncs data to the replica and the coordinating node then responds to the client.
